review_evidence: README identifies a Rocq/Coq formalization of Selinger’s “Remarks on Matsumoto and Amano’s normal form”.
All four current-primary .v files are the small formal corpus itself: Gaussian-integer and quantum/normal-form developments rather than build or generated report files.
Build/template metadata lives outside the .v primary set, so no content-lossless primary exclusion was established.
summary: Retain all four Coq formal sources for the Selinger normal-form formalization.
